titulo: Exhibit B: the breath you skipped.
caption:
Physiological sigh, Exhibit B: the breath you skipped. A pause before reacting, kept in a frame.
When a message tightens my jaw: two in, one out. Then write back.
If you feel light-headed, breathe normally.
The tool is on the page: link in bio.
by NMR
